nodes.name: IT/AV Helpdesk Support
nodes.core_duties: Provide on-site and remote IT/AV support for 40-100 end users, including Zoom room AV, event support, phone system diagnosis, and desktop support.

nodes.name: Transfer Office Sourcing Program Manager
nodes.core_duties: Measure and report on the execution of the material transfer process between suppliers; collect and analyze data, develop KPIs, prepare dashboards, and provide insights to optimize transfer operations and supplier performance.

nodes.name: 系统管理员
nodes.core_duties: 负责安装、维护、升级和保护公司软件、硬件及网络，管理IT基础设施并为内部用户提供硬件和软件支持；同时负责局域网/广域网、网络安全、服务器、备份、域账户、M365/Azure、SQL Server和Dynamics NAV等系统的日常运维。

nodes.name: Manager Issue Management
nodes.core_duties: Manage lifecycle of assigned problems, perform root cause analysis, coordinate corrective actions, ensure service level agreements are met, maintain problem inventory in ServiceNow, identify trends and process improvements, and oversee team risk management.

nodes.name: Android逆向工程师
nodes.core_duties: 负责对Android应用和SDK进行逆向工程和安全评估，通过静态与动态分析检测恶意行为，开发检测签名并撰写报告。

nodes.name: UX设计师
nodes.core_duties: Responsible for creating user interaction task flows, mock-ups, wireframes, and prototypes, applying usability and human factors principles, and collaborating with development teams and product managers to ensure intuitive user experiences and design quality.

nodes.name: Microsoft 365 Lead Architect
nodes.core_duties: Lead architecture, deployment, administration, and optimization of the enterprise Microsoft 365 platform, including identity and access management, device management, automation, and security; provide technical leadership, escalation support, and drive continuous improvement across IT and business teams.

nodes.name: Salesforce Engineering Manager
nodes.core_duties: Manage full lifecycle of Salesforce development projects, lead design and implementation of complex solutions, oversee code reviews, testing, deployment, and maintenance; collaborate with cross-functional teams and ensure security, governance, and performance compliance.

nodes.name: Senior Reporting Analyst
nodes.core_duties: Design, develop, and implement advanced PowerBI solutions including dashboards, reports, and data models; collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver actionable insights for data-driven decision-making.

nodes.name: Senior Cloud Solutions Architect
nodes.core_duties: Design and architect scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud solutions, lead technical discussions, and mentor junior architects.

nodes.name: SRE Manager
nodes.core_duties: Lead a team of SREs to design, implement, and maintain highly scalable, secure, and reliable cloud-based systems; optimize database performance and automate operations while ensuring high availability and alignment with business goals.

nodes.name: Performance Tester
nodes.core_duties: 负责Guidewire云应用及遗留系统的性能测试策略制定、工具配置、脚本开发、负载/压力/耐久性测试执行、性能监控与缺陷管理，并与架构、业务团队协作定义非功能需求。

nodes.name: Systems Engineer II (Okta)
nodes.core_duties: Design, administer, install, and support systems, software, and security with a focus on Okta. Secure user applications, manage identity and access governance, implement advanced authentication, and maintain Microsoft 365 and Windows Server environments.

nodes.name: IT Manager
nodes.core_duties: 负责管理IT基础设施，包括Okta、Jamf、Intune、Zoom、Google Workspace和Atlassian套件的管理与支持；处理支持工单，配置和撤销应用访问，提供Windows、Mac、iOS、Android平台的问题解决，并管理内外部支持人员及供应商。

nodes.name: Web Editor & Digital Accessibility Specialist
nodes.core_duties: Manage and enhance university public websites and intranet, ensuring digital accessibility compliance, optimizing site performance, SEO, and UX, while leading web-related projects and providing training to content contributors.

nodes.name: ETL Engineer
nodes.core_duties: Design, develop, and deploy scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and data platforms to process and organize structured and unstructured data; work in an agile environment with cross-functional teams to support data-driven missions such as fraud detection and cancer research.

nodes.name: Senior Software Engineer, Back End
nodes.core_duties: Collaborate with Agile teams to design, develop, test, implement, and support technical solutions. Utilize programming languages and cloud technologies to deliver robust cloud-based solutions.

nodes.name: System Analyst
nodes.core_duties: Work with attorneys and KM team to identify, implement, manage, and support knowledge management technology solutions; administer KM systems and databases, develop AI-driven knowledge capture, provide training and documentation, and evaluate effectiveness.

nodes.name: Software Development Engineer
nodes.core_duties: Design and implement software features and components in a team-oriented agile environment, primarily using Java and GraphQL, while partnering with product management to deliver customer features.

nodes.name: Manufacturing Technical Applications Specialist
nodes.core_duties: Apply IS manufacturing knowledge to select, deploy, and support manufacturing solutions across production sites; manage projects and integrations to enhance operations efficiency.

nodes.name: Biomedical Technician
nodes.core_duties: Respond to service calls to evaluate, diagnose, perform repair and planned maintenance on biomedical equipment, and ensure customer satisfaction through service excellence.

nodes.name: Information System Security Officer
nodes.core_duties: Manage information security systems for classified and unclassified systems, ensuring RMF/NIST compliance, supporting ATO/ATO efforts, conducting risk analysis, and maintaining security posture across on-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments. Participate in Agile planning events and create security documentation.
